title: Choose the Sheltered Link Atlas composition
question: The visual world is fixed. Choose which Nearby composition should become the measured implementation contract.

options.label: Atlas + anchored cat sheet
options.lineage: map-first discovery with one selected cat
options.thesis: The coarse neighbourhood atlas leads; one cat rises from it in a focused anchored sheet.
options.viewport: Large privacy-safe atlas, contextual safety note, then a spacious selected-cat sheet immediately above the tab bar.
options.risk: The selected sheet is tall and leaves less room for browsing multiple areas.

options.label: Atlas + area rail
options.thesis: A keyed area rail turns the atlas into a usable discovery control before the selected cat opens.
options.viewport: Large atlas, three privacy-safe area states, compact selected-cat sheet and familiar five-tab navigation.
options.risk: The extra area rail adds density and needs careful large-text behavior.

options.label: Cat-first split atlas
options.lineage: identity and care before spatial context
options.thesis: Recognition comes first, with the coarse atlas supporting rather than leading the decision.
options.viewport: Large cat portrait and care state above a supporting coarse-area map and one nearby report action.
options.risk: The photo/map split is less efficient when users want to scan several nearby cats.
